% Synthetic M3b fixture: font families and real bold/italic faces.
% Invented content. The families are the ones shipped in fonts/ beside this
% file, so the fixture renders the same on every host: Source Serif Pro (CFF)
% carries all four variants, Open Sans (TrueType) too, Source Code Pro one.
\documentclass{article}

\fonts{
  dir = "fonts",
  body = "Source Serif Pro",
  sans = "Open Sans",
  mono = "Source Code Pro",
}

\pdfmeta{ title = "Faces" }

\assert{ pages == 1 }
\assert{ fonts.all_embedded }

\begin{document}

\section{Faces}

Body text is set in the serif family. \textbf{This clause is bold} and
\textit{this clause is italic}, while \textbf{\textit{this one is both}}.
Inline \texttt{monospaced code} switches family, and {\sffamily a sans run}
does too.

\begin{itemize}
  \item \textbf{Bold label} followed by ordinary text.
  \item \emph{Emphasis} toggles italic, so \emph{nested \emph{emphasis}}
  returns upright.
\end{itemize}

\end{document}
